description: This file defines the class `RetrieveFeatureDefinitionResponse`, which represents the response to a 'RetrieveFeatureDefinition' command in a remote device management context. It includes methods for creating instances, parsing from JSON, and accessing the retrieved feature definition and associated metadata. The class is part of a package related to querying feature definitions of 'things' in the Eclipse Ditto framework.
